Message.Name: Top Of Book Message
Message.Description: The Top Of Book (TOB) message is generated when the top price level has been modified. TOB messages for different markets (SSE and SZSE) are sent via different channels.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading. 6 digit security codes with possible values 1 to 999999.

Field.Name: AggregateBidQuantity
Field.Description: Aggregated number of shares on the bid side. Provides Virtual Auction Volume during Call Auction period.

Field.Name: AggregateAskQuantity
Field.Description: Aggregated number of shares on the ask side. Provides Virtual Auction Volume during Call Auction period.

Field.Name: BidPrice
Field.Description: The bid price. Provides Virtual Auction Price during Call Auction period. 3 implied decimal places. 0 means N/A.

Field.Name: AskPrice
Field.Description: The ask price. Provides Virtual Auction Price during Call Auction period. 3 implied decimal places. 0 means N/A.
